name: MLBClient
summary: A standalone Minecraft launcher with its own client: one-click installs, profiles, Modrinth mods, emotes, cosmetics and a free daily-credit shop.
description: MLBClient is a standalone launcher for Minecraft Java Edition by Jonaz Productions. It installs Minecraft, Fabric, Java and the MLBClient client for you, keeps every profile separate and verifies every download. In game, MLBClient adds an emote wheel, cosmetics that other MLBClient players can see, and the full module set of its predecessor QuickClient.
coverAlt: MLBClient Launcher home screen with the Play button and a player skin

seo.title: MLBClient – Minecraft Launcher (Beta)
seo.description: MLBClient is a standalone Minecraft launcher by Jonaz Productions: one-click installs, profiles, Modrinth mods, modpack import, emotes and cosmetics. Beta 1 launches on 15 November 2026.

sections.title: MLBClient Launcher Beta 1
sections.availableText: Beta 1 launches on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 16:00 CET.
sections.requirements: Windows 10/11 (x64) or Linux. A Minecraft Java Edition account (Microsoft login).
sections.notes: The beta is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning (More info › Run anyway).

sections.title: Everything in one launcher.
sections.intro: Features that are in Beta 1 today.

items.title: Install & play in one click
items.text: The launcher sets up Minecraft, Fabric, Fabric API, Java and the matching MLBClient build. Every file is checked by checksum, and damaged files are found before the game starts.

items.title: Minecraft versions
items.text: MLBClient for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3, QuickClient for 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3. Install, update, repair or remove each one.

items.title: Profiles
items.text: Every installation is a profile with its own name, colour, client, version and folder for mods, configs and worlds.

items.title: Mods from Modrinth
items.text: Search Fabric mods by category and add them to a profile. Import Modrinth .mrpack files and CurseForge Fabric modpacks.

items.title: Cosmetics
items.text: A locker with every cosmetic you own. What you equip in the launcher is what other MLBClient players see in game.

items.title: Shop & daily rewards
items.text: Collect credits every day: 50, plus 10 for every day in a row up to 100, and 100 welcome credits. Unlock emotes and cosmetics with them. No real money.

items.title: Skins & accounts
items.text: Log in with Microsoft through the official device-code flow, use several accounts, and upload or reset your skin.

items.title: Settings
items.text: Memory, recommended or own Java, window size, game folder, English or German. Sensible defaults for beginners.

items.title: Update notice
items.text: The launcher shows a banner with a download button when a newer launcher version is published.

sections.title: The client inside.
sections.intro: MLBClient 0.1.0-beta is the successor of QuickClient and is installed by the launcher automatically.

items.title: Emote wheel
items.text: Hold G to pick an emote. Emotes are shared with other MLBClient players near you, including music emotes played with note blocks.

items.title: Shared cosmetics
items.text: Capes, hats, wings, auras and more, visible to other MLBClient players. New cosmetics can arrive without a mod update.

items.title: 45 modules
items.text: Everything from QuickClient 1.0.2: HUD editor, minimap, world map, waypoints, keystrokes, zoom and more, in a new module menu (K).

items.title: Client icons
items.text: MLBClient players get a small purple M at their name tag, QuickClient players a green Q. Can be switched off.

entries.title: MLBClient Launcher Beta 1
items: Profiles: every installation is a profile with its own folder for mods, configs and worlds
Modpack import for Modrinth .mrpack and CurseForge Fabric modpacks
QuickClient in the Versions tab next to MLBClient (MLBClient stays the default)
Mods page with Modrinth search, categories and per-profile installs
Shop with daily credits, cosmetics locker and skin page

entries.title: From QuickClient to MLBClient
items: New name and mod id; QuickClient settings, waypoints, notes and maps are taken over on first start
New look: glass panels, new main menu and module menu
Emote wheel with shared emotes, music emotes and the Sakura collection
Launch Collection: The Launch, MLB Hype, The Comeback and New Era, free for one week from the beta launch
Shared cosmetics, including the Autumn collection for free

entries.title: The predecessor
items: QuickClient, the Fabric client mod that MLBClient grew out of, is available on CurseForge
